name: Rensa-Nexus Multi-Stock Locations
author: RensaBYDP

sections.description:
Manage WooCommerce product stock across up to five locations, with transfers and automatic synchronization of the combined total.

Open WooCommerce > Stock Manager to view totals per location, search inventory, transfer stock, and configure locations. Assign each location as Retail Stock, Warehouse Stock, or Internal only. Set location quantities in the product editor or Quick Edit; active locations also appear as columns in the standard WooCommerce product CSV import and export. Transfers move quantities between locations without changing the product’s total.

WooCommerce stock quantity and stock status are synchronized with the sum of all configured location quantities. Existing WooCommerce stock is initially treated as stock in the first configured location. WooCommerce product CSV import and export include a stock column for each configured location.

On single product pages, customers see only the combined Retail Stock and Warehouse Stock totals. Internal-only locations are never displayed.

External services

This plugin does not connect to any external service or send any data. The Support tab only displays links to the author’s websites (rensa.co.za and nexus.rensa.co.za) and a support email address; these are opened only when you click them.

Privacy

The plugin stores only stock quantities (product meta) and location names (one option). It collects no personal data and sets no cookies.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the rensa-nexus-multi-stock-locations directory to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Configure locations under WooCommerce > Stock Manager > Locations.
  4. Enable stock management for a product and set quantities for its locations.
sections.faq:
How are existing WooCommerce quantities handled?

Until location quantities are first saved, the existing stock quantity is treated as inventory in the first configured location.

How many locations can I use?

Up to five. Locations categorized as Retail Stock or Warehouse Stock are aggregated on the product page; Internal only locations are not shown to customers.

Does a stock transfer change the product’s WooCommerce stock total?

No. Transfers move quantities between locations and keep the total unchanged.
